difficulty_reason: Restriction along a cartesian cofinal subcategory of sites is an equivalence on quasi-coherent dg modules: constructs the quasi-inverse from a good representative M' (lemma-resolve), checks objectwise that M'(U') is K-flat and graded flat and that the base-change maps are quasi-isomorphisms, and verifies the two compositions are isomorphic through the colimit-over-slice comparison E(U) -> colim E(U') tensor A(U). Retained author proof at lines 6290-6355.
